task.title: M4: Graph view starts fully expanded
task.description:
The dependency graph currently opens collapsed to the first directory level, which hides most of the structure on first look. Open it fully expanded instead: every directory compound is open and every file node visible, with the full layout run once on first render. Collapsing a directory (double-click or the toggle) still works and aggregates its edges as today, and Re-layout and Fit behave as before. Keep the initial render acceptable on Capacitor (about 360 files, 700 edges); if the layout takes more than about two seconds, use a faster layout preset for large graphs rather than collapsing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Opening #view=graph on codeviz, workbook, and Capacitor shows all file nodes and all edges with no directory collapsed; the summary bar counts match the snapshot totals.
- Collapsing a directory still aggregates its edges and keeps other nodes in place; expanding it again restores its files.
- Fit runs after the initial layout so the whole graph is visible.
- Capacitor's initial graph render completes in under ~2s in headless Chrome and remains interactive (pan, zoom, hover) with no console errors.
- The cycle panel still lists cycles and clicking one focuses the files.
